evals.prompt: How do I connect my agent to Google Stitch so it can read my project screens?
evals.expected_output: Gives the remote MCP endpoint (stitch.googleapis.com/mcp) and X-Goog-Api-Key header (API key), notes a restart is needed, and verifies with a list_projects call.

evals.prompt: Our Stitch home screen has low-contrast buttons. Just fix the screen directly.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to overwrite the original; proposes REFINE variants or a new design system, and asks approval before any overwriting call.

evals.prompt: Apply our design system to screen 98b50e2ddc9943efb387052637738f61 with apply_design_system.
evals.expected_output: Explains apply_design_system needs screen instance ids from get_project, and that applying to originals needs approval.

evals.prompt: A Stitch screenshot URL ends in =w390, but the downloaded screen is very tall. How can I inspect it safely?
evals.expected_output: Metadata/HTML may be read first, but do not read or attach any image until checking decoded width and height, creating a proportional preview with a longest edge <=1600 px, and verifying the preview dimensions. Preserve the original.

evals.prompt: I need a visual review of a tall Stitch page in the browser. Can I use a full-page screenshot at device scale 2?
evals.expected_output: Rejects full-page screenshots, checks devicePixelRatio and both physical width/height bounds derived from CSS dimensions before capture, and uses bounded viewport captures for tall content.

assertions.value: (?:DPR|devicePixelRatio)[\s\S]*(?:physical width and height|physical dimensions|both physical dimensions|both axes|CSS width and height|physical output dimensions|both dimensions)

(?:both|each)[\s\S]*(?:dimensions|axes|width and height)[\s\S]*(?:<=|at most|within|fit|no greater than)[\s\S]*(?:1600|1,600)|(?:CSS width[\s\S]*(?:DPR|devicePixelRatio)[\s\S]*(?:<=|at most|within|fit)\s*1600[\s\S]*CSS height[\s\S]*(?:DPR|devicePixelRatio)[\s\S]*(?:<=|at most|within|fit)\s*1600)|(?:1600\s*[×x]\s*\d+|\d+\s*[×x]\s*1600)[\s\S]*(?:both|each)

evals.prompt: Stitch generation returned an image-size error. Should I call generate_screen_from_text again?
evals.expected_output: Does not infer the backend write failed; checks returned screen IDs, get_screen, or metadata/completed output before retrying and never blindly repeats a write. If oversized inline images are possible, requires a documented host resize/text-only route before the call or blocks.

assertions.value: (?:avoid|no|without|do not|don't|never)[\s\S]*(?:blindly retry|blind retry|duplicate|repeat generation|generate again|retry)|(?:only retry|retry only)[\s\S]*(?:after|when|if)[\s\S]*(?:checking|inspect|existing|completed|metadata)

evals.prompt: An existing OMP session is failing because it retained a huge screenshot. Is /compact enough, and can I use /help to find cleanup?
evals.expected_output: Discovers advertised commands before invoking /shake images, preserves source screenshots before cleanup, acknowledges that all conversation image blocks are removed, and states /compact is not guaranteed and /help is not assumed supported.

assertions.value: \/compact[\s\S]*(?:not guaranteed|not a guaranteed|may retain|not reliable)|\/help[\s\S]*(?:not advertised|not supported|don't assume|do not assume)
